value.rationale: Determines the sharp least possible nonconstant population period in a natural recently studied dynamical model, supplies a rigorously enclosed realization preserving physical logistic parameters, and explains an intrinsically weak but unavoidable linear instability with an explicit 32/a^2 clock. This distinction is material to transient quasi-periodic interpretations and not a mere restatement of textbook logistic-map period doubling.
